WITH CustAccMax AS (     SELECT customer_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_acc     FROM (         SELECT customer_id, year_mount, COUNT(DISTINCT deposit_id) AS cnt         FROM dbo.Deposit_Monthly_Activity         WHERE year_mount BETWEEN 140401 AND 140412         GROUP BY customer_id, year_mount     ) m     GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT      COUNT(*) AS n_institutional,     SUM(CASE WHEN max_acc >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_ge_100 FROM CustAccMax WHERE max_acc >= 100

WITH InstCust AS (     SELECT DISTINCT customer_id     FROM (         SELECT customer_id, year_mount, COUNT(DISTINCT deposit_id) AS cnt         FROM dbo.Deposit_Monthly_Activity         WHERE year_mount BETWEEN 140401 AND 140412         GROUP BY customer_id, year_mount         HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT deposit_id) >= 100     ) t ), Bal140412 AS (     SELECT customer_id, SUM(bal) AS bal     FROM (         SELECT customer_id, deposit_id, MAX(avr_total_amount_eq) AS bal         FROM dbo.Deposit_Monthly_Activity         WHERE year_mount = 140412         GROUP BY customer_id, deposit_id     ) d     GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT      SUM(CASE WHEN i.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.bal ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(b.bal) AS inst_dep_share_pct FROM Bal140412 b LEFT JOIN InstCust i ON b.customer_id = i.customer_id
